name: ATRX chromatin remodeler

function.text: ATRX encodes an ATP-dependent chromatin-regulatory protein that works with DAXX in deposition of histone H3.3 and maintenance of repetitive chromatin, including telomeric regions.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to ATR-X-related syndrome (x-linked); alpha-thalassemia/impaired intellectual development syndrome, X-linked (x-linked).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations are described across multiple tumor groups, including Liposarcoma; Osteosarcoma; Paraganglioma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
